{{Quote|I am Ceremony, Gala and Ritual droid designation CGR-80. You may call me "Seeger." Shall we begin your joining?|CGR-80|<ref name="Modest" />}}
'''CGR-80''', also known as '''Seeger''', was a [[Ceremony, Gala, and Ritual droid]] with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], and [[Gold/Legends|gold]] plating that was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Marriage/Legends|Marriages]] through the [[Terms of Bonding]], and [[Rodian harvest festival]]s were among the many rituals and ceremonies that the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] was capable of performing.<ref name="Modest" />

==Behind the scenes==
CGR-80 appeared in the conversation "A Modest Proposal" with [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]], a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If female Knights accept Doc's proposal of marriage, he will summon CGR-80, and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] will marry the two of them with the Terms of Bonding.<ref name="Modest" />
